rdfs:label: authentication
rdfs:comment: On a DID Document, the verification methods authorised for proving control of the DID — used during login, challenge-response, and other identity-assertion flows.
notes: One of several *verification relationships* in DID Core (alongside `assertionMethod`, `keyAgreement`, `capabilityInvocation`, `capabilityDelegation`). Distinguishing them lets a DID controller use a hardware key for authentication while delegating signing to a software key — the same Document, different keys for different purposes.

examples.title: DID Document declaring an authentication key
